name: text-and-source-product-gates-v1

build_policy.reason: Use the upstream zpaq target but override its -march=native default so the research binary is not host-instruction-specific.

deterministic_command_policy.admission_rule: Count the complete journaling archive and require two measured complete artifact SHA-256 values to match before labeling ZPAQ deterministic.

research_ceiling.resource_policy: Run official method 5 in exact single-input mode with complete archive accounting; start at -m510 only after the practical census and enforce the 18 GiB local peak-RSS cap.

build_policy.reason: Use upstream CMake with its C++17, safe floating-point, generic CPU, bundled-zlib, and single-build-job settings.

absolute_ceiling_commands.host_requirement: Larger isolated host with safe headroom beyond the upstream 32 GB+ warning.

local_resource_screen_commands.claim_label: Local resource-bounded paq8px evidence only; never absolute paq8px ceiling.

external_asset_policy.reason: Upstream identifies plain -12L as the fair fully self-contained maximum. Pretraining dictionaries, embeddings, expressions, executable-specific state, and saved LSTM weights are not stored in the archive and would be required again by the decoder.

research_ceiling.archive_accounting: Use single-file mode with an explicit output. Upstream states that this mode stores contents only and no paths, names, timestamps, attributes, permissions, or other metadata; count every output byte and require two measured hashes to match.
research_ceiling.resource_policy: The absolute upstream ceiling is -12L with no external pretraining files. A local -11L run is resource-bounded evidence only and cannot stand in for -12L; -12L requires a larger isolated host.

build_policy.reason: Use the upstream cmix target with the upstream documented -O3 compatibility mode instead of -Ofast -march=native.

research_ceiling.portable_build_policy: Use -O3. Do not use -Ofast -march=native because the upstream README warns that floating-point precision differences can make archives incompatible across computers.

required_decoder_assets.accounting: Report payload-only installed-codec context separately, but add these dictionary bytes once to the primary self-contained ceiling artifact.

prohibited_assets.reason: Upstream documents this as enwik9-specific preprocessing state; enwik9 is diagnostic-only and the asset is inapplicable to the frozen source/Wikimedia items.
Optional external preprocessing is not admitted unless separately pinned, reversible, completely accounted, and predeclared before any run.

research_ceiling.resource_policy: Run the strongest source-audited text mode only on a larger isolated host with safe headroom beyond the upstream 32 GiB recommendation. Count or reject every external dictionary or model dependency.

build_policy.reason: Use the exact upstream Linux target and its shipped flags while linking the pinned redistributed LibNC runtime from the same archive.

bundled_runtime_identity.accounting: Treat the executable and pinned LibNC library as disclosed installed-codec dependencies, exactly as codec executables are treated for every baseline. They are not per-artifact bytes, but a result is ineligible for portability claims until the same artifact decodes exactly on a second declared compatible host.

absolute_ceiling_commands.admission_rule: The enwik9 name denotes the strongest shipped 20-layer transformer parameter profile, not external weights or a published-score shortcut. Its parameters and seed are written into the artifact. Use the upstream text preprocessor only for the Wikimedia track where its exact 16384,512 recipe is documented; keep source bundles raw rather than inventing an unvalidated tokenizer setting.

self_contained_archive_policy.counted_bytes: Count the complete NNCP output. The file header stores the model parameters and seed; when preprocessing is enabled, NNCP generates the vocabulary from the input and zlib-compresses that vocabulary into the same output.
self_contained_archive_policy.external_weights: None admitted. Encoder and decoder initialize the same model from seed 123 and train it online from the coded symbols.
self_contained_archive_policy.reason: External preprocessed inputs or coefficients break self-contained framing, encode-only output is documented as undecodable, and max_size truncates the declared input.

research_ceiling.determinism_and_portability_gate: Require two complete artifact SHA-256 values to match on the pinned CUDA host, exact restoration for every run, the precise GPU/CUDA/LibNC/build identity, and a second-host exact decode before any portability claim. If GPU arithmetic is not cross-host reproducible, retain NNCP only as same-host research context and label that limitation.
research_ceiling.resource_policy: Run only on a separately authorized Linux/CUDA host. Upstream reports 1 GB CPU plus 6.6 GB GPU memory and 2.8 days for its enwik9 example on an RTX 4090; enforce the research wall-time gate and report timeout or unavailability rather than treating either as an Axiom win.

comparability_policy.practical_gate: The ratio-oriented product must beat the smallest eligible practical_required complete artifact. Every required baseline must be reproduced on identical derived bytes or marked infrastructure-failed; missing, unavailable, timed-out, or inexact baselines cannot be counted as wins.
comparability_policy.research_context: Research-ceiling compressors never disappear from the chart. A product may pass the practical gate without beating them, but no strongest-ratio, world-best, or state-of-the-art wording is allowed unless it also beats every eligible completed research-ceiling result under exact complete accounting.
comparability_policy.single_file_rule: All competitors receive one identical derived category item and produce one self-contained decodable artifact. Directory metadata, solid-archive advantages, external models, preprocessors, and dictionaries must be equally framed and counted.
comparability_policy.famous_benchmark_rule: Published enwik8/enwik9 results are context only and never substitute for a same-run frozen split.

research_budget.reason: Research-ceiling runs are ratio context, not a practical speed tier. This Mac has exactly 32 GiB installed, so the local 18 GiB cap preserves defensible OS and harness headroom; unrestricted ceiling runs retain explicit larger-host requirements.

decision_rule: A track and mode pass only if every applicable requirement passes on the first authorized public-validation score. No representation, model, dictionary, selector, threshold, corpus rule, baseline setting, evaluator, or gate may change after validation acquisition.
claim_rule: A public-validation pass supports only the exact track scope. Private-holdout success and independent reproduction are additionally required before state-of-the-art wording; all eligible research-ceiling results must also be beaten before a strongest-ratio or world-best claim.
